newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK OF CYPRUS INTRODUCES CUSTOMER SERVICE STAFF.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF CYPRUS INTRODUCES CUSTOMER SERVICE STAFF.

text.p: The Bank of Cyprus is introducing customer service staff in its branch network to assist clients, it announced on Tuesday.
"The battle for dominance in the banking sector will depend on the quality of service provided to clients and not the level of interest rates," the bank said.

Trained customer service staff will be present in all of its branches to field questions and direct clients to the proper department whatever their needs. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
